messages:
Iris (product): Quick check — sales flagged two urgent asks: (A) per-route cost alerting in Console, and (B) reliable link from error rows -> a trace or a deterministic pointer for audits. We need to pick what ships in Q over next PI.
Noah (eng): Agree both important but different cost profiles. Cost alerts = data-aggregation + rules engine. Trace pointer = small index write at ingest. Pointer is lower infra lift.
Fel (sre): Ops reality: cost alerts need rollups every minute and retention tie-ins. Risk: alert noise if we do naive thresholds. Suggest percentile-based alerts + anomaly detection gate. Pointer approach: cheap index writes, but reconstructs still cold IO.
June (design): UI thoughts: cost alerts should be configurable per-workspace with templates (e.g., "monthly cost spike > 20%"), and notify channels. Error rows: show a micro-pill "trace id" (copyable) or a CTA "reconstruct" with expected latency and cost. Keep both visible.
Marta (acct): From contracts, customers want exportable proof to reconcile billing. If trace pointer exists we can map invoice lines -> pointer. For full reconstructs we must require opt-in/paid add-on. Legal will need export audit.
Iris (product): Prioritization proposal: 1) Pointer write on error + invoice mapping export (beta) 2) Basic cost alerting MVP (static thresholds + CSV export) 3) Recon/priority reconstruct as paid add-on. Launch criteria: pointer visible in >95% error tiles in beta customers; cost alerts firing with <5% false positives in pilot; audit log for every reconstruct.
Noah (eng): Est: pointer write + index + API = 1 sprint. Cost alerting MVP = 1.5 sprints (ingest rollups + rules + webhook). Recon infra spike = 2 sprints. Need to budget for backfill of pointers for historical errors.
Fel (sre): Ops items: alert throttles, dedupe logic, per-org alert quotas, export job queue for reconstructs, immutable audit entries, and a billing meter. SLOs: cost alert delivery < 30s for 90% in pilot.
June (design): Ill mock cost-alert setup page and error-card pointer UI. Include microcopy that explains export costs and redaction.
Marta (acct): I'll draft pricing language: free pointer + CSV mapping; paid tier for guaranteed handles + fast reconstructs. Will take to legal.
Iris (product): OK action items: Noah opens RFC with pointer schema + cost-alert pipeline; Fel drafts ops runbook; June drops mocks; Marta coordinates legal/terms. Planner-bot: scheduled RFC review for 1765070000.
